author: Qixit
body:
Hello, this will be one of the first maps I post here. I originally made this/these maps for the Overcast Network but they were never added. Ocaliren is a DTM map with custom trade items to spice up game-play. The map must be completed in the time frame of 40 minutes with two teams of 30 people (35 max). There is three objectives each team must go for, the valley monument, left-hillside and right-hillside. Hope you enjoy!
New Map Download
Images

http://pastebin.com/5DBZd7wL[YML]
